Nothing here is on `main`## Phase C: the `vqa3d` core

Code: [components/blender-visual-qa/vqa3d](../components/blender-visual-qa/vqa3d/README.md). Run it from the
component folder:

```bash
cd components/blender-visual-qa
python3 -B -m vqa3d route "move the cube in blender and check it moved"
python3 -B -m vqa3d probe
python3 -B -m vqa3d check --adapter blender --scenario vqa3d/scenarios/blender_move.json
```

| Piece | What it does |
|---|---|
| `contract.py` | `EnvAdapter` (`probe`, `capture`, `scene_state`, `act`, `close`) and `Observation` (frame sha256 of decoded RGB, canonical integer state, `capture_available`) |
| `canon.py` | Canonical JSON that refuses floats, NaN, infinity and booleans used as numbers; explicit quantisation |
| `check.py` | `verify_step`: capture before, act, capture after, judge one obligation (`state_change`, `state_equals`, `frame_change`, `no_change`) |
| `verdict.py` | `PASS`, `FAIL`, `CANNOT_SEE`, `ADVISORY`, `ERROR`, worst wins; verdict codes and stage codes in separate tables; a judge `ADVISORY` counts as `CANNOT_SEE` |
| `receipt.py` | `vqa3d.receipt/v1`: before and after observation ids, state change, verdicts, `receipt_sha256`; mirrors field names of `action_receipt/v0.2` without claiming schema validity |
| `route_intent.py` | Intent to adapter by a keyword table, with code coordinates from the route index; abstains with rc 3 |
| `fakes.py`, `traces/` | Replay of recorded live runs for CI, and a cross-run comparison that reports non-deterministic replay |

Rules that come from the verified phase P pack: an unavailable capture never passes a pixel obligation;
a model judge can only make a result worse; integer-only state; pixels and state belong to one
observation identity; claims about performance, grader accuracy and cross-platform determinism stay
absent until measured.

| Adapter | Status | How it works | Evidence [MEASURED, 15 Nov 2026, this host] |
|---|---|---|---|
| Blender | implemented | `blender -b` on a scratch copy of a `.blend`, integer actions (micrometres, millidegrees, ppm), canonical object state, small Workbench PNG; owned process group with bounded waits | move scenario PASS, wrong-obligation scenario FAIL (rc 1) |
| MuJoCo | implemented (a simulation) | in-process `mujoco`, offscreen `Renderer` (`MUJOCO_GL` kept if set, else `egl`), state from `qpos`, `qvel`, time and contacts quantised to integers | the same scenario twice gives byte-identical receipts; same host, model and runtime only |
| AutoCAD, NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim | not_implemented | `probe` says so, every call raises `AdapterNotImplemented`, `check` returns `CANNOT_SEE` rc 3 | no output is produced |

Tests: 61 unit tests in `components/blender-visual-qa/tests/test_vqa3d_*.py` pass with and without
`mujoco` installed. They include mutants that must be caught (action not applied, wrong object
changed, frozen frame, capture unavailable, float in state, non-deterministic replay), checked by
deleting each detector. [tests/test_vqa3d_core.py](../tests/test_vqa3d_core.py) runs them in hosted CI.
Hosted CI has neither Blender nor MuJoCo, so it replays recorded traces; live behaviour is claimed
only from the run logs above.
